title: Incorrectness is bounded by estimate failure
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $0<\tau\le1$. The probability that the Goldreich–Levin query program produces a state that is not correct is at most the probability that its estimate trace contains an estimate with error at least $\tau^2/4$ from the corresponding restricted Fourier weight.
